biography.value:
Description

A spirit that floats in the air, giving of a faint light. It is quite a sight to see groups of these wandering around, and it is even said in ancient texts they used to congregate around humans and were even quite friendly. It is still unknown at what point and why st. elmos began attacking humans. There are many researchers in Mysidia researching whether or not there's a way to return to their friendly beginnings.

Defense

AC 24, touch 24, flat-footed 14 (+3 deflect, +9 dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)

hp 45 [78] (13d6)

mp 67

Fort +4, Ref +17, Will +11

Defensive Abilities natural invisibility;

Immune magic;

Weakness Shadow;

Offense

Speed fly 50 ft.(perfect)

Melee Shock +16 touch (2d8 holy damage)

Special Abilities Fiddle

Languages Aklo, Common, Elvaan

description.value: Once every 1d6+1 rounds, the wisp's ability to create a surprisingly pleasant sound not unlike that of a tiny fiddle. The wisp creates a catchy tune that compels any creature within a 20-foot spread to dance and caper. A creature can resist this compulsion by making a successful Will save (DC 19). Creatures that fail are compelled to dance and shuffle their feet, and are effectively staggered for the duration of this spell. Once a creature makes the save against this spell, it is immune to further fiddle effects from that caster for 24 hours. This is a sonic mind-affecting effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).

save.description: Negates the dancing compulsion and grants immunity to this caster for 24 hours.

effect: Mind-affecting sonic compulsion. Failed save: effectively staggered while dancing. Successful save: immune to this caster's Fiddle for 24 hours. No duration is printed here.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).

description.value: Wisp are immune to all spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance, except spells with the dark descriptor.

effect: Reject spells and spell-like abilities allowing SR, except those with the dark descriptor.

description.value: Wisp have the ability to extinguish their natural glow as a move action, effectively becoming invisible, as per the spell.

effect: Extinguish the natural glow, becoming invisible as the spell.

description.value: Invisible after extinguishing glow.

Give to a creature that failed its Will save. While compelled to dance it is staggered. The entry gives no fixed duration; end the buff when the compulsion ends. A successful save grants 24-hour immunity to this caster.
